title: Commercial Ad Creatives & Social Visual Design Suite
summary: A 9-piece commercial graphic design portfolio engineered in Figma and Canva Pro, spanning 3D kinetic product drops, deconstructed food infographics, luxury lifestyle ads, event posters, and editorial book illustration.
problem: E-commerce brands, restaurants, and event organizers struggle to capture attention on crowded vertical social feeds when relying on plain product photos without clear visual hierarchy, price anchoring, and benefit callouts.
whatIDid: Designed high-impact 3D & promotional product ads (Volt Run X1 Kinetic Sneaker Drop & Stackhouse Double Trouble BOGO) using motion speed-trails, warm studio rim lighting, and clear price anchors (₱3,299 / ₱149) with direct 'Shop Now' CTAs.

Built deconstructed & ingredient callout infographics (Tala Coffee Co. 3-Step Cold Brew & Stackhouse 7-Layer Burger Breakdown) using numbered pointer lines to turn product specs into thumb-stopping educational visuals.

Crafted luxury lifestyle & editorial compositions (Haven & Wick Soy Candle, Ember & Co. Smokehouse Grill, and The Door in the Oak Book Cover) balancing tactile textures, serif typography, and multi-plane papercut illustration.

Created event & lead-generation marketing posters (Golden Hour Sunset Music Festival & Focus Lab 5-Day Study Workshop) combining retro 70s typography, flatlay desk photography, and urgency-driven ticket/seat reservation triggers.
result: Delivered a versatile 9-piece commercial creative suite across 5 industries (Food & Beverage, Footwear, Home Lifestyle, Events, and Publishing), formatted in native 1080×1350 (4:5) and 1080×1620 (2:3) portrait ratios for high-CTR social campaigns.
